summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors' resolution to submit a merger of its wholly-owned subsidiary Esfera Fidelidade S.A. into the Company for shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting on June 30, 2026. This is a vertical merger of a wholly-owned subsidiary to optimize operational structure in Brazil, consolidating loyalty program services. No purchase price, premium, or third-party advisors are disclosed as the transaction involves no change of control or external consideration. The merger is internal and non-cash, requiring only shareholder approval. Watch for EGM outcome and potential minority appraisal rights, though no risk-arb spread exists.
